review_outcome: Admission-ready for one new physical campus after the corrections listed below. The proponent's statutory EC compliance letter, dated 3 August 2026 and uploaded to PARIVESH on 5 August, says the data centre is under construction phase. SEIAA's EC letter places the named plot inside the CAF KML polygon, and the campus does not intersect or alias any of the 197 selected sites.

lifecycle_review.route: Public PARIVESH compliance endpoints: getPublicDataByProposal lists the compliance report for the proposal, previousCompliance returns its upload timestamp and fields, and getAllDocs with compliance_report_id 1237477223 returns the cover letter as doc_3 and the portal acknowledgement PDF. No login, token or form submission.
lifecycle_review.finding: The signed and sealed letter dated 03/08/2026 encloses the six-monthly EC compliance status of Raiden's Turbhe MIDC data centre for December 2025 to March 2026. A separate present-tense final body sentence states that the data centre is under construction phase. The portal acknowledgement generated for this upload (PDF created 2026-08-05T22:13:57Z) records five proponent condition submissions dated 04/08/2026, also in the present tense. They describe drinking water supplied at site, an air-quality display at the main gate, third-party noise monitoring, waste segregation and green-belt development under way.
lifecycle_review.date_format: The letter's date is read day-first as 3 August 2026. This follows Indian convention, the PDF creation timestamp 2026-08-04T21:31:52+05:30, the portal's day-first 04/08/2026 entries and the 5 August upload. A month-first reading (8 March 2026) would predate the end of the period the letter reports on.
lifecycle_review.date_semantics: The status sentence is read as status at the letter date, not the nominal period, consistent with the Thane admission's May 27 cover letter: it is a separate present-tense sentence in a signed letter dated 3 August 2026, and the proponent's portal entries dated 04/08/2026 also describe current on-site arrangements. The 5 August upload, also inside the window, is when the statement became public. Neither date is an inspection day. If a reviewer reads the sentence as describing the December 2025 to March 2026 period instead, the candidate reverts to hold, as with Digital Edge BOM and ESR MU1.
lifecycle_review.predecessor: SEIAA's EC letter of 27 November 2025 (page 5, item 20) and the CAF both record that no construction had started under the earlier 2023 jewellery-park EC for this plot. Physical work therefore began after the November 2025 EC and is reported by 3 August 2026. The listing's commencement_date of 27 November 2025 (IST) equals the EC grant date and is not selected as a start date.
lifecycle_review.scope: Broad project under_construction only. 'Construction phase' is not normalized to a finer stage, and no building count, completion percentage, commencement certificate, capacity or operation is inferred.
lifecycle_review.successor_review: Recaptured on 2026-10-09, the proposal is still EC Granted and the compliance listing still holds only this report. Bounded searches found no opening, completion, withdrawal, cancellation, MPCB closure direction or stop-work order for this plot through August 20. They covered PARIVESH and English-language web reporting on Raiden Infotech, Turbhe and Juinagar, and Google's Navi Mumbai plans; 2026 Google India construction coverage concerns the separate Visakhapatnam project. Completion by August 2026 would also be inconsistent with a 149,170 m2 built-up-area clearance granted in November 2025 on a plot where nothing had been built.
lifecycle_review.absence_limit: Bounded original-source and web review, not an exhaustive permit, MPCB consent, court or site-inspection audit. Web search results were screened, not captured, and are not relied on.

identity_review.bridge: The cover letter cites EC letter SIA/MH/INFRA2/531703/2025 (typed 'SIA/MH/1NFRA2/531703/2025') and is doc_3 of compliance report 1237477223. The compliance index, the listing and the CAF record carry the same proposal number, project name, plot address and legal entity. The CAF binds the proposal to the active 'raiden kml.kml' attachment, whose polygon is named 'Raiden Plot Boundary'. SEIAA's signed EC letter for the same file states the location as GEN-2/1/A/1 D-Block Turbhe MIDC, a site coordinate that falls inside that polygon and a plot area of 90,568 m2, within 0.13% of the polygon's geodesic area.

predecessor_ec_same_plot.relation: Raiden's CAF records this as the existing EC for the site, with 'No further action after EC', and describes converting the gold-jewellery park into a data centre with no construction under that EC. The site is one plot redeveloped by a new holder, not a second campus.
predecessor_ec_same_plot.kml_anomaly: The predecessor's 'Gold Craft.kml' attachment is a LineString titled 'Gramercy Data Centre plot boundary' at about 72.9994-73.0019 E, 19.1676-19.1689 N in Airoli (portal villages Elthan and Arewali), about 12.6 km north of GEN-2/1/A/1. It evidently depicts a different Gramercy site, so it is not used, and it is not evidence against the Raiden polygon. Raiden's polygon is separately corroborated by SEIAA's coordinate, the EC plot area and the 400705 Turbhe postcode.

identity_review.uncaptured_context: 2024 trade reports, screened by search and not captured or relied on, described Google negotiating for a 22.5-acre MIDC leasehold in Juinagar then leased to Gramercy Trade Industries. That is consistent with the plot's 9.0568 ha (about 22.4 acres) and the KML document name 'JNG SITE.kml'.
identity_review.portal_field_caveats: The EC cover page's 'Grant of Terms of Reference' subject and 'Fresh ToR' type are a generic template; the SEIAA letter grants EC. The district fields reading MUMBAI follow the applicant's office district; the KML plots and the EC copy to the District Collector, Thane, place the site in Thane district. The CAF's 'shape_of_project: Linear' conflicts with the polygon and is not used.
identity_review.roles_guardrail: No owner, operator, developer, tenant, user or affiliate role is selected. The letterhead's corporate contact domain and the CAF's personal contact fields are not recorded.

independent_geometry_review.recapture: The 2026-09-26 lane capture and the 2026-10-09 root recapture are byte-identical; the 2026-10-02 attempt failed at the network layer.
independent_geometry_review.selected_feature: Placemark index 9, 'Raiden Plot Boundary': nine coordinate tuples (eight distinct vertices plus closing repeat), one outer ring, no holes, zero altitudes.
independent_geometry_review.source_crs: WGS 84 longitude/latitude under the normative KML 2.2 definition (OGC 07-147r2 section 6.2 and Annex B, EPSG datum 6326). No datum conversion, geocoding, snapping, fitting or tracing.
independent_geometry_review.precision: All 18 ordinate values (16 distinct, plus the closing repeat) are kept exactly as the source text; each round-trips through binary64 unchanged.
independent_geometry_review.area_comparison: 116.4 m2 (0.13%) below the EC plot area and CAF total land of 90,568 m2. PARIVESH's 'actual project area' of 89,672.4 equals the EC's FSI area, not land area. No fitting or correction is applied.
independent_geometry_review.ec_coordinate_crosscheck: SEIAA's 19 3 19.57 N, 73 1 23.99 E (datum unstated) lies inside the polygon, 0.10 m from the KML 'Raiden Project' point and 6.6 m from the display anchor; it is not selected.
independent_geometry_review.caf_extent_crosscheck: The CAF's ne_extend and sw_extend equal the polygon's bounds digit for digit, but they are portal-derived from this KML rather than independent of it.
independent_geometry_review.corner_markers: Eight 'Point 1' to 'Point 8' placemarks lie 0.63-2.00 m from distinct polygon vertices; they are not selected.
independent_geometry_review.osm_crosscheck: Excluded. Two Overpass API queries were captured as an optional shape cross-check. A later robots check found that overpass-api.de/robots.txt disallows /api/ for all user agents, as does www.openstreetmap.org/robots.txt. Both captures are therefore excluded, and no finding, statistic or locator in this review depends on them. No named OSM feature was proposed as a locator in any case.
independent_geometry_review.display_anchor_method: Planar shoelace centroid of the source ring in source vertex order, recomputed independently and verified inside the ring; identical to the 2026-10-02 proposal.
independent_geometry_review.uncertainty_caveat: No source states positional accuracy or survey method. The polygon is a government-hosted proponent locator, not an official boundary, cadastral survey, building footprint or work extent.
